retainedRedirected.reason: Retired 8 Oct 2026 (3c5d84906, before the parent archive): every locale /ppc-thanks/ path 301s to the same-locale /thanks/ in next.config.ts (english-candidate/ppc-thanks-redirects.json); the strict live-runtime guard rejects the redirect (attempt-01, /hi/ppc-thanks/). The body is unreachable behind the 301, so the parent bytes are retained unchanged.
